# Reference photos of the fox templates

The REFS, KEYFRAMES and CONTINUE_REFS templates load three photos from Wikimedia
Commons into their Media Loaders (`fox_1.jpg`, `fox_2.jpg`, `fox_3.jpg` in your
ComfyUI `input` folder). The photos are **not** part of this repository; the
clips in `assets/` (fox_refs, fox_keyframes, fox_continue_refs) and the two
Part VII screenshots of the handbook were made with them.

| File in the templates | Commons file | Author | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fox_1.jpg` | [Vulpes vulpes ssp fulvus 26568101.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vulpes_vulpes_ssp_fulvus_26568101.jpg) | Joanne Redwood | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |
| `fox_2.jpg` | [Vulpes Vulpes, Island Beach State Park, NJ 04.jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vulpes_Vulpes,_Island_Beach_State_Park,_NJ_04.jpg) | peggycadigan | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) |
| `fox_3.jpg` | [Vulpes vulpes (32846612491).jpg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Vulpes_vulpes_(32846612491).jpg) | xulescu_g | [CC BY-SA 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/) |

Changes: the photos were used unchanged as inputs; the clips are new renders by
MiniMax H3 guided by them (REFS: as subject references; KEYFRAMES: as first frame
and guides).
